CustomField.label: EMI Amount
CustomField.formula: IF(OR(ISBLANK(Loan_Amount__c), ISBLANK(Interest_Rate_Percent__c), ISBLANK(Loan_Tenure_Months__c), Loan_Tenure_Months__c <= 0), 0, IF(Interest_Rate_Percent__c = 0, Loan_Amount__c / Loan_Tenure_Months__c, (Loan_Amount__c * (Interest_Rate_Percent__c / 12)) * (EXP(Loan_Tenure_Months__c * LN(1 + Interest_Rate_Percent__c / 12))) / (EXP(Loan_Tenure_Months__c * LN(1 + Interest_Rate_Percent__c / 12)) - 1)))
